description: Defines an immutable data object 'OfficeData' used for representing office information within the Fineract project, including factory methods and fields for office attributes.

classes.name: OfficeData
classes.description: Immutable data object for office data, with factory methods for creating instances and fields for office attributes.

methods.name: importInstance
methods.description: Creates an OfficeData instance for import purposes with specified name, parentId, openingDate, and externalId.

methods.name: setImportFields
methods.description: Sets import-related fields: rowIndex, locale, and dateFormat.

methods.name: testInstance
methods.description: Creates a test OfficeData instance with specified id and name.

methods.name: dropdown
methods.description: Creates an OfficeData instance suitable for dropdown selections with id, name, and decorated name.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Creates a template OfficeData with default opening date and parent lookups.

methods.name: appendedTemplate
methods.description: Creates a new OfficeData by appending allowedParents to an existing OfficeData.

methods.name: hasIdentifyOf
methods.description: Checks if the OfficeData's id matches the given officeId.
